strings.name: Özlem Türeci
strings.summary: Trained in medicine at Saarland, Türeci moved from clinical work into cancer antigens, antibodies and personalized immunotherapy, co-founding Ganymed and BioNTech with Şahin, Huber and others. Linking laboratory and clinical development, she became CMO in 2018 and helped teams develop a COVID-19 vaccine with Pfizer. In 2026 she announced a planned new venture; cancer candidates still require clinical validation.
